question: Find the IDs of players who scored the highest number of partnership runs for each match. The output should include the IDs of two players, each with their individual scores and the total partnership score. For each pair, the player with the higher individual score should be listed as player 1, and the player with the lower score as player 2. In cases where both players have the same score, the player with the higher ID should be player 1, and the player with the lower ID should be player 2. There can be multiple rows for a single match.

WITH match_data AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.match_id,
        bb.innings_no,
        bb.ball_id,
        bb.striker,
        COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs,
        COALESCE(wt.player_out, 0) as wicket_player
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    WHERE bb.striker IS NOT NULL
),
with_wickets AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE WHEN wicket_player > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as wicket_flag
    FROM match_data
),
with_segments AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        ball_id,
        striker,
        runs,
        CAST(SUM(COALESCE(wicket_flag, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY ball_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS INTEGER) as segment_id
    FROM with_wickets
),
bat_segment_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        segment_id,
        striker,
        SUM(runs) as total_runs
    FROM with_segments
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, segment_id, striker
),
partnership_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        br1.match_id,
        br1.innings_no,
        br1.segment_id,
        br1.striker as p1,
        br2.striker as p2,
        br1.total_runs as runs1,
        br2.total_runs as runs2,
        br1.total_runs + br2.total_runs as partnership_total
    FROM bat_segment_runs br1
    JOIN bat_segment_runs br2 ON br1.match_id = br2.match_id 
        AND br1.innings_no = br2.innings_no 
        AND br1.segment_id = br2.segment_id 
        AND br1.striker < br2.striker
),
standardized_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        segment_id,
        CASE WHEN runs1 > runs2 OR (runs1 = runs2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p1 ELSE p2 END as player1,
        CASE WHEN runs1 > runs2 OR (runs1 = runs2 AND p1 > p2) THEN p2 ELSE p1 END as player2,
        GREATEST(runs1, runs2) as player1_runs,
        LEAST(runs1, runs2) as player2_runs,
        partnership_total
    FROM partnership_pairs
),
ranked_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        player1,
        player2,
        player1_runs,
        player2_runs,
        CAST(partnership_total AS INTEGER) as partnership_total,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY partnership_total DESC, player1_runs DESC, player1 DESC) as rn
    FROM standardized_pairs
)
SELECT match_id, innings_no, player1, player2, player1_runs, player2_runs, partnership_total
FROM ranked_partnerships
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY match_id, innings_no
